statements.scope: verdict answered: an experiment with a computed control now meets it
statements.conditions: Measured: the color weave dresses 1.7 to 2.3 times wider than the turning weave (E-FRC-0125). Its full battery passes for both signs at sides 7, 9 and 11, and a rule written before the numbers chooses it (E-FRC-0148). The answer is a comparison at one box size, not a bound: those supports are capped by the side-9 box, and on an unbounded lattice most lone vibes dress without bound under the committed knit as under the color-local ones (E-CMP-0015).
